source.identity_note: Two player-seasons have records at different colleges. Preserved to match original curve; source review remains needed.
source.population: All eligible player-seasons; colleges represented by an ever-drafted player; minimum 20 minutes and 10 team-season games.
source.outcome: Ever-drafted status, repeated across eligible seasons; not annual selection.
source.binning: Original 4 lower-region and 7 upper-region equal-width intervals.

grouped.family: Each bin 1-9 versus the SAME fixed final two bins pooled
grouped.method: One-sided single-step max-t Rademacher cluster multiplier bootstrap of centered rate-difference influence functions
grouped.correction: G/(G-1); original standard errors retained in bootstrap; empirical higher 95th percentile for lower bounds
grouped.assumptions: Approximate independence between connected college groups; adequate effective group/event counts; conditions on original bins and outcome-filtered cohort.
grouped.limitations: Exploratory; no adjustment for historical window, band, bin-count, tail-width, panel choice or outcome-based college inclusion. No causal or whole-shape claim.

independent.family: Each bin 1-9 versus the SAME fixed final two bins pooled
independent.method: One-sided max-t independent-ROW Rademacher multiplier bootstrap
independent.assumptions: Every player-season row is independent, including repeated rows for the same player. Diagnostic only; no college or repeated-player dependence allowance.
independent.limitations: Exploratory; no adjustment for historical window, band, bin-count, tail-width, panel choice or outcome-based college inclusion. No causal or whole-shape claim.
